column3: Close to the Hebrew; עִם־ כּוּשׁ (“with Cush”) is rendered “with Ethiopia,” and NKJV marks the verse as God’s speech.
Close to the Hebrew; יִסְפֹּר (“will count”) is rendered “will record.”
Close to the Hebrew; כְּחֹלְלִים (“dancers”) is rendered “the players on instruments,” and NKJV supplies “say.”
